🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive (Sector Strength). Leadership concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5); confirmed by strong cross-sector breadth and pronounced Technology weakness (Tech: 4/19 positive) — mixed signals warrant neutrality.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads: CHTR (1W: +22.63% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +19.28% | 1M: +18.88%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +13.09% | 1M: +11.45%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: TGT (1W: +12.18% | 1M: +11.78%) ABOVE TREND, PEP (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +18.77%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing strength: XOM (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +17.73%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +10.61%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -14.00% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -7.40%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -11.63% | 1M: +4.67%) CORRECTION. Financials mixed: JPM (1W: +5.49% | 1M: -4.59%) RECOVERY, PYPL (1W: -24.13% | 1M: -30.80%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary tepid: TSLA (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -10.11%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CHTR (1W: +22.63% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +19.28% | 1M: +18.88%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +16.63% | 1M: +30.12%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +15.22% | 1M: +21.88%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +13.09% | 1M: +11.45%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ACN (1W: -10.64% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -11.44% | 1M: +12.87%) CORRECTION, AMAT (1W: -11.63% | 1M: +4.67%) CORRECTION, CRM (1W: -12.51% | 1M: -22.17%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -14.00% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: CHTR (1W: +22.63%), VZ (1W: +19.28%), DOW (1W: +16.63%). Major divergence present (≥3 large-cap names with 1W ≠ 1M like AMAT, NEM, JPM) — treat as tactical, watch for trend confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Sector weak and in CORRECTION: AAPL (1W: +7.82% | 1M: +3.45%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier while MSFT (1W: -14.00% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -7.40%) BELOW TREND drive sector pain; Tech: 4/19 positive (Sector Weakness).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mixed/turning RECOVERY in parts: JPM (1W: +5.49% | 1M: -4.59%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +6.17% | 1M: -2.50%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +0.91% | 1M: -6.74%) RECOVERY — Financials: 14/20 positive (Internal Rotation).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive bid intact: JNJ (1W: +2.96% | 1M: +14.76%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +8.14% | 1M: +6.30%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +8.18%) ABOVE TREND — Healthcare: 12/15 positive (Sector Strength).

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to leading cyclicals and defensives showing strength (XOM (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +17.73%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +12.55%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to weak large-cap Tech names showing confirmed downside (MSFT BELOW TREND, CRM BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given strong breadth but concentrated top performers.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CHTR (1W: +22.63% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +16.63% | 1M: +30.12%) ABOVE TREND, PEP (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +18.77%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AMAT (1W: -11.63% | 1M: +4.67%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -14.00% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -24.13% | 1M: -30.80%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (Breadth strong), Consumer Staples (Breadth strong). BEARISH: Technology (Tech: 4/19 positive) — watch for spillover into growth indexes.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
CHTR above €/resistance after breakout (1W: +22.63% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND; AAPL support watch ~ prior pivot (AAPL (1W: +7.82% | 1M: +3.45%) ABOVE TREND); MSFT key downside confirmation if it closes below recent lows (MSFT (1W: -14.00% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND).

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+80): JNJ (1W: +2.96% | 1M: +14.76%) ABOVE TREND — FDA/approvals news confirming price strength. PFE (+55): PFE (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +8.18%) ABOVE TREND — positive Phase 2b obesity readout confirming move. BA (+55): BA (1W: -2.33% | 1M: +3.43%) CORRECTION — earnings/orders bullish but 1W weakness signals partial distribution.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-65): UNH (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -19.33%) BELOW TREND — DOJ probe news confirming near-term weakness. AMAT (-55): AMAT (1W: -11.63% | 1M: +4.67%) CORRECTION — weak guidance headlines diverge from 1M strength, watch for follow-through. QCOM (-60): monitor for confirming price data (news-driven risk to semiconductor demand).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. XOM (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +17.73%) ABOVE TREND and CHTR (1W: +22.63% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while MSFT (1W: -14.00% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND and AMAT (1W: -11.63% | 1M: +4.67%) CORRECTION are key downside risks. Watch major-tech divergences vs. broad sector strength and news-confirmed moves in Healthcare (JNJ, PFE).
